description: This Java source file defines a DAO class JpaNotificationRequestDao for managing NotificationRequest entities in a SQL database within the Thingsboard platform. It implements methods for querying, updating, and deleting notification requests, and is annotated for Spring and Lombok integration.

classes.name: JpaNotificationRequestDao
classes.description: DAO class for NotificationRequest entities, providing database operations such as find, update, delete, and existence checks, using Spring Data JPA and custom utility methods.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndOriginatorTypeAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds notification requests by tenant ID and originator type with pagination.

methods.name: findInfosByTenantIdAndOriginatorTypeAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds notification request info objects by tenant ID and originator type with pagination.

methods.name: findIdsByRuleId
methods.description: Retrieves list of notification request IDs associated with a specific rule ID and tenant.

methods.name: findByRuleIdAndOriginatorEntityIdAndStatus
methods.description: Finds notification requests by rule ID, originator entity ID, and status.

methods.name: findAllByStatus
methods.description: Finds all notification requests with a specific status, with pagination.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates the status and stats of a notification request by its ID.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndStatusAndTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a notification request exists for a tenant, status, and target ID.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndStatusAndTemplateId
methods.description: Checks if a notification request exists for a tenant, status, and template ID.

methods.name: removeByTenantIdAndCreatedTimeBeforeBatch
methods.description: Removes notification requests created before a certain timestamp in batches.

methods.name: findInfoById
methods.description: Finds notification request info by ID.

methods.name: removeByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all notification requests for a tenant.
